# Test fixtures

Test-only files. They are never loaded by the application at runtime.

| File | Provenance |
|---|---|
| `two-pages.pdf` | Generated by `make_fixtures.py` in this folder (hand-written PDF objects, Helvetica text, page 2 rotated 90°). No third-party content. |
| `blank-scan.pdf` | Generated by `make_fixtures.py`: two pages with no text layer (simulates a scan). |
